title: Fullscreen and minimized player
description: Move between compact, fullscreen and minimized playback without losing your track or queue.

steps.caption: 1. Play a Sample Pack. Its green controls identify samples.
2. Choose Full screen from the persistent player's position menu.
3. The fullscreen view includes transport, waveform and the current pack playlist.
4. Close the fullscreen view to minimize, rather than stop, playback.
5. Expand returns to fullscreen. The track and pack queue are preserved.
